subject: Training-on-customer-data opt-out -1 confirmation and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acmefin.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo follow-up - data handling recap and opt-out request

Hi Elena - thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and next steps from my side (keeping this short):

- Key asks we captured on the call:
  * PII handling: AcmeFin requires that any sensitive customer PII be redacted before it is stored for analytics.
  * Data residency: Production data must remain in the US region.
  * Retention: Logs and payloads retained for no more than 90 days, unless otherwise agreed.
  * Training-on-customer-data: AcmeFin is evaluating an opt-out (Redwood should not use AcmeFin customer data to improve or fine-tune global models).
  * Auditability / logs: Need audit logs for API access and inference requests for 90 days.

Action items / asks:
- Elena: please confirm if AcmeFin will opt-out of training-on-customer-data. If yes, please confirm the exact language you want in the DPA/SOW (we can propose standard text).
- Connor: please follow up with the technical details for retention and audit logs (CC'd).
- Marissa (me): I'll loop in Rishi from legal once Elena confirms so we can ship a brief DPA addendum and DocuSign.

I've attached our SOC2 summary for reference [Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf].

If you confirm opt-out, we'll mark it on the deal and provide the addendum within 48 hours. Happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up with your legal/procurement team if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the following from AcmeFin: 

- We will opt-out of training-on-customer-data. Redwood should not use any AcmeFin customer data to improve or fine-tune models outside of the scoped, contracted evaluation environments.
- 90-day retention for logs and payloads is acceptable.
- Data residency in the US required (no replication to EU/APAC).
- We need an explicit addendum to the DPA with the opt-out clause and a short technical appendix describing retention and logging controls.

Looping in procurement to coordinate DocuSign and PO. Procurement contact is procurement@acmefin.com. Please include Rishi from legal on the addendum draft.

Thanks - I appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elena Rossi
Director, Platform Engineering | AcmeFin
elena.rossi@acmefin.com

Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up - data handling recap and opt-out request

Elena - quick technical note following Marissa's message and your confirmation.

On implementation:
- Opt-out flag: We'll mark AcmeFin as "training_opt_out" at the tenant level in our control plane. When set, telemetry and user payloads associated with the tenant will be excluded from model training pipelines and any global model improvement workflows.
- Logs & retention: All inference request payloads and API logs will be retained in our US logging cluster with a 90-day TTL. After 90 days the payloads are purged from hot storage and removed from long-term analytics indexes.
- Auditability: We can enable a read-only audit export (CSV) for access logs covering the 90-day window - we'll provide the format in the technical appendix.

I've attached the draft technical appendix describing the controls and retention flows [Attachment: Data-Retention-Controls.docx]. If you'd like, we can schedule a 20-minute call this week to walk your security team through the appendix.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
